title: Consultant - AWS & Linux
description:
Date: Nov 5, 2026

Job Requisition Id: 65172

Location:
Hyderabad, TG, IN

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire Windows Server Admin Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Experience**
--------------

5-8Years

**Job Description**
-------------------

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Lead P1/P2 to resolution
* Maintain accurate technical documentation and inventory logs.
* Optimize performance across VMware clusters and Azure resources.
* Implement security hardening guidelines across all operating systems.
* Plan and execute major and minor change requests
* Root cause analysis and corrective action items
* Anaylsis of capacity and availability data
* Mentor junior engineering teams and lead technical code/architecture reviews.
* Manage infrastructure capacity planning and multi-million dollar cloud budgets.
* Driving key KPI improvement month on month
* Drive Knowledge Management , Process management, Client sign off
* Drive Key initiatives, CSIP, Automations , Customer Value additions
* Drive Ticket Reduction, Effort Reduction,
* Lead Client discussion on Key initiatives driving and outcomes
* Lead MSR/QBR , drive Ops as per Client Sensitivities and Priorities
* Understanding of Benchmarking , Best practices as per industry standard and peer companies which can be driven in the area assigned
* Understanding and adopting AI in the area of operation and able show value addition to client.
* Drive CSAT and TCSAT >4.5 /5
  

QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:

* Bachelor’s degree
* 8+ years of experience, with at least 3 years in a lead capacity.
* ITIL v4 Foundation Certification
* Candidates who are confident of clearing extensive Background verification till previous Organization only shall apply.
  

PREFERRED SKILLS:

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* VMware Certified Advanced Professional (VCAP).

BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES:

* Analytical problem-solving approach.
* Proactive ownership of issues.
* Collaborative team player mindset.
* Strong executive stakeholder communication.
* Calm under high-pressure situations.

**Required Technical/ Functional Competencies**
-----------------------------------------------

PRIMARY SKILLS:

* Windows Server: Administration of Windows Server 2016/2019/2022, Active Directory, DHCP and DNS.
* Advanced Windows: Active Directory architecture, cluster management, and advanced troubleshooting.
* VMware Administration: vCenter management, vMotion, HA, DRS, and vSAN configuration.
* Azure Cloud: Deploying ARM/Bicep templates, managing Azure Backup, Recovery Services, and Load Balancers.
* Hybrid Cloud Architecture: Designing enterprise-scale Windows, VMware, and Azure integrated environments.
* Azure Governance: Enterprise Landing Zones, Azure Policy, cost optimization, and CAF frameworks.
* Disaster Recovery: Designing SRM (Site Recovery Manager) and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) solutions.
* Automation: Advanced PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation.
* Fluent in English, in both oral and written communication
* Willingness to do 24x7 Rotational Shift, ability to working from office is preferred, location will be city with Yash Office.

DESIRABLE SKILLS:

* FinOps: Cloud cost management, forecasting, and budget allocation strategies.
* Experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) or containerization.
* Enterprise storage network design (SAN/NAS).

**Required Behavioral Competencies**
------------------------------------

**Accountability:**

* Takes ownership for and ensures accuracy of own work, meets deadlines, and asks questions about possible gaps to ensure clarity of ownership.

**Agility:**

* Demonstrates a willingness to accept and embrace differing ideas or perceptions which are beneficial to the organization.

**Collaboration:**

* Participates in team activities and reaches out to others in team to achieve common goals.

**Customer Focus:**

* Displays awareness of customers stated needs and gives priority to meeting and exceeding customer expectations at or above expected quality within stipulated time.

**Communication:**

* Effectively communicates in written and oral form, well-organized thoughts to others. Speaks openly and honestly with all employees.

**Drives Results:**

* Demonstrates a "can do" attitude and is willing to stretch self to achieve and exceed defined goals/targets.

**Certifications**
------------------

Mandatory: CA, AZ104, MCSA, Business Intelligence Development Certification, Microsoft Certified Azure AI, Azure Data & Azure Administrator; Desirable: OCP, CCP/Yash defined course, Administration level Certification of any Storage Tool/Backup Tool

Mandatory: ITIL V4 Foundation

NCA - Nutanix Certified Associate

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture
